items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So Harry Smith the trumpet player, great trumpet player that lived around Kansas City, was in this show

ctx.x: This is in Tulsa, Oklahoma. I guess this was -- this must have been about 1924. You know? About 1924. I'm 14 years old now, see, going on 14. So Harry Smith the trumpet player, great trumpet player that lived around Kansas City, was in this show, and Pigmeat Markham was the comedian in this show, and we went and persuaded the woman, people that owned the show, to let us ballyhoo out front, and that's bally up just before the show was going to start inside. We would get out there and blow, and attract attention,…
And for this she gave the band $4.00 a day. So we would take that $4.00. Now we could eat, you see, and what-
